title: Clo Summit New York 2025 🗽
description:
Enjoy the highlights from the CLO Summit New York this year - our biggest US event to date! This year's theme was "Blueprint for Success", focusing on practical strategies for 3D adoption. We were thrilled to welcome over 300 industry professionals and see many familiar faces. 
Thank you to everyone who attended - we look forward to seeing you next year!

summary: # Clo Summit New York 2025 🗽 ## Team Collaboration and Energy It's the one time a year that our team really hunkers down and gets a lot of stuff done together. They pull all-nighters; it kind of feels like going back to college again. Then we release this great product to create a community with all of our users, and it's just such a great feeling to see everyone here. The energy is really high. ## Insights from Experience I've been at my company for about a year, and we just started implementing processes. So, to hear from people who have been in it for five to seven years and have actually gone through this is really helpful for us. It allows us to say, "Okay, maybe we should do that; maybe we should try this." We love hearing feedback and thoughts directly from users. We also appreciate hearing what they really liked and what they want improved. ## User Engagement and Feedback Seeing how everybody's using the software really quickly and easily from everyone gives us a lot of opinions at once. My favorite thing about this summit is that we get to see all of our clients recognizing each other from last year and trading tricks and tools they've learned over the years. ## Excitement for New Features There's so much excitement with all of the new features within Clo. We are definitely diving into it once we get back to figure out how we can apply this to our current workflow and learn from there. We're super excited about the great content presented today. ## Process Improvement in the Industry How can we improve our processes inside our brands? We live in a huge bubble of enterprises in the fashion business, and we don't actually look around that much. So being here, sharing with Nike, talking with Ibram Kroby, and chatting with the Hugo Boss VP of Supply Chains really helped me visualize how big this can be. ## Potential of 3D Technology How big can we go with 3D technology, with DPC, inside Pharma and other brands? This summit opened my eyes to the fact that we need to fast-track our development. Clo has so much more potential than we realize, and the foundations we lay today are just the beginning. We can't even imagine yet where it can go in the future, and I think there’s more than what we're currently seeing. ## Commitment to User Feedback Clo really cares about their users' opinions and is open to our feedback. I feel like that’s what we're going for. This commitment to user feedback is what makes this relationship and the software so successful and useful. ## Belief in the Future of Clo I love the company, I believe in Clo, and I think it’s definitely the future.
